HomeHeroSection.text1: At WL, we believe coffee is more than just a drink.
HomeHeroSection.text2: It's a feeling, a moment, a small pause in a busy day.
HomeHeroSection.text3: Every cup we create starts with carefully selected beans, rich aromas, and a passion for doing things beautifully. From the first morning espresso to a slow afternoon coffee with someone you love, we’re here to make every moment a little warmer.
HomeHeroSection.text4: Take a breath. Slow down. Enjoy the moment.
HomeHeroSection.text5: Because the best coffee is always made with love.

OurCoffeeTitleSection.text: Carefully selected beans, one cup at a time.

AboutHeroSection.title: About Us
AboutHeroSection.textH3: A small pause in a busy day.
AboutHeroSection.text1H4: WL started with one idea: coffee should feel like care.
AboutHeroSection.text2H4: We pick every bean by hand, roast in small batches,
AboutHeroSection.text3H4: and serve each cup the way we'd serve it to a friend.
AboutHeroSection.textP: Since 2020, we've been making moments a little warmer.
